legit.title: fix: resolve connection leak in worker pool (#452)
legit.body: Fixes #452. Under high concurrent load, connections were not being returned to the pool due to unhandled exceptions in the keep-alive handler. Added try/finally block and comprehensive regression unit tests.

+        try:
+            return conn.execute(task)
+        finally:
+            self.release(conn)

+def test_connection_pool_leak_on_exception():

+    assert pool.available_connections() == 5

first_timer_legit.title: fix: prevent memory leak in cache store (#105)
first_timer_legit.body: Fixes #105. Under high write load, entries were not evicted properly. Cleared stale references and added regression tests.
